disposition: Additive P1.11 only. Frozen P1.1…P1.10.1 registers remain byte-identical. P1_MIGRATION_REFERENCE_MISSING is reused from P1.10 for binding arguments; configuration errors stay P1_MCP_CONFIG_INVALID.

codes.reference_rule: P1.11 MB-1…MB-3: bound method is neither imported from a pinned catalog nor declared locally
P1.11 MC-3, MB-3, MV-5: binding roles, arity or argument concept types do not match the method
P1.11 MP-1…MP-4, MV-2…MV-4: binding contradicts the declared plan
